technique_name: Describe how Naive Bayes works for classification.
description: Naive Bayes is a supervised machine learning algorithm which is used for classification. It is based on Bayes' Theorem which states that the probability of an event given some background information is the product of the probability of the event occurring and the probability of the background information being true.
